For the exact rational parameter witness, independent rational algebra derives R0, B and both derivatives, shows positive-endemic domain (0,105/8), and proves B has one positive critical point by a strictly increasing quadratic. The two positive treatment-rate equilibria have all six residuals exactly zero; verify.py checked the actual expressions. No dynamical trajectory or empirical inference is asserted.

value.rationale: Treatment control of R0 is the source paper’s central management criterion; occupancy of E+I+T+F is a separate natural capacity-sensitive equilibrium endpoint, particularly because isolated F patients remain cases without transmitting. The model-specific inequality and one-peak exact witness show a material reversal, not a bookkeeping identity, between decreasing transmission potential and increasing clinical caseload. This can prevent false inference from threshold improvement to aggregate demand; no claim of demonstrated real-world harm or paper-size contribution.
